Legacy radish distance wrapper

Source: R/radish_grid.R
legacy_radish_distance_wrapper.Rd

Deprecated compatibility wrapper retained for older code that still calls radish_distance().

Usage

radish_distance(...)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed through the deprecated radish_distance() compatibility wrapper to terradish_distance.

Value

A list of class terradish_grid (also inheriting radish_grid) containing the parameter grid theta and either distance, an array of resistance distances, or covariance, an array of graph covariances when covariance = TRUE. The first two array dimensions index focal sites; the third indexes parameter-grid rows. See terradish_distance.
